name: softload-blogger
description: Gerador procedural de templates XML para Blogger

scripts.typecheck: npm run check:typescript-native && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit && node scripts/check-typescript-mirrors.js && node scripts/audit-typescript-migration.js
scripts.typecheck:workers: TS_MIRROR_DIAGNOSTICS=1 node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --project tsconfig.workers.json --noEmit && node scripts/check-typescript-remaining.cjs && node --test scripts/browserWorkers.test.cjs scripts/browserErrorLog.test.cjs scripts/browserSentinel.test.cjs
scripts.check:typescript-native: node -e "const {execFileSync}=require('node:child_process');const out=execFileSync(process.execPath,['node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc','--version'],{encoding:'utf8'});if(out.trim()!=='Version 7.0.2')throw new Error('Compilador nativo TypeScript 7 não ativo: '+out);console.log(out.trim())"
